Prince Harry's UK visit marked by privacy lawsuit loss and accommodation dispute

Prince Harry's recent visit to the UK was characterized by two significant events: the dismissal of his privacy lawsuit against a tabloid publisher and a dispute over accommodation at a royal residence. The High Court ruled against Harry and other celebrities, stating they failed to prove unlawful information gathering by the publisher. Separately, reports indicated a disagreement regarding his potential stay at Buckingham Palace, with his wife and children not accompanying him on the trip.
